placements.note: Of or relating to cats; belonging to the cat family (Felidae). From Latin fēlīnus (of cats), from fēlēs (wildcat, marten). Also used of catlike qualities.
A member of the cat family (Felidae). By back-formation from Felidae (taxonomic family name), from fēlis.
